segments.contextAfter: `action`: The behavior to be set. Use [`kSecTransformActionAttributeNotification`](ksectransformactionattributenotification.md) to add a block that is called when an attribute is set. If the name is `NULL`, then the supplied block is called for all set attributes except for ones that have a specific block as a handler. Use [`kSecTransformActionAttributeValidation`](ksectransformactionattributevalidation.md) to add a block that is called to validate the input to an attribute.
